meta.title: Trust in the media
meta.question: How much do Poles trust the press, television and the media?
meta.measure: Average trust in the press, television and the media, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on trust or confidence in the press, television and the media, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in the press?
items.notes: EVS, 1990, 1999, 2008, 2017 (4 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.
CDCEE, January 1991 and March 2000. 'Totally / to a certain point / little / not at all'.

items.wording: Confidence in the press (full / moderate / none)
items.notes: PGSS 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1997, 1999 (6 surveys); 'pełne / umiarkowane / nie mam zaufania'. Version x of the battery: asked of everyone 1992-95, of a random half (split ballot with version y) in 1997 and 1999.

PGSS 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1997, 1999 (6 surveys); 'pełne / umiarkowane / nie mam zaufania'. Version x of the battery: asked of everyone 1992-95, of a random half (split ballot with version y) in 1997 and 1999.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in the press?
items.notes: WVS Poland, 1989, 1997, 2005, 2012 (4 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in television?
items.notes: WVS Poland, 1997, 2005, 2012 (3 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.

items.wording: Does the press deserve trust? (definitely deserves ... definitely does not)
items.notes: PGSS 1997, 1999, 2002, 2005, 2008, 2010 (6 surveys); 'zdecydowanie zasługuje na zaufanie ... zdecydowanie nie zasługuje', midpoint 'ani ... ani'. Version y of the battery: random half of the sample in 1997, 1999 and 2002, everyone from 2005.

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the press?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2001.1, 2002.2, 2003.2, 2003.4, 2004.1 (5 surveys). 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust'.

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust television?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2001.1, 2002.2, 2003.2, 2003.4, 2004.1 (5 surveys). 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust'.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust newspapers? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-01, 2004-01, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2010-01, 2012-01, 2014-01, 2014-03, 2016-01 (9 surveys). CBOS biennial trust battery ('Czy, ogólnie rzecz biorąc, ma Pan(i) zaufanie, czy też nie ma Pan(i) zaufania, do ...'), four answers plus 'trudno powiedzieć'. Labels vary: '... - X' (2002, 2004, 2010-16), 'zaufanie do K) X' (2006-01), 'zaufanie do X' (2008-01). In 2014 the battery was split across APiW 284 (January) and 286 (March). Asked in both 2014 halves of the battery.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust television? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-01, 2004-01, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2010-01, 2012-01, 2014-01, 2014-03, 2016-01 (9 surveys). CBOS biennial trust battery ('Czy, ogólnie rzecz biorąc, ma Pan(i) zaufanie, czy też nie ma Pan(i) zaufania, do ...'), four answers plus 'trudno powiedzieć'. Labels vary: '... - X' (2002, 2004, 2010-16), 'zaufanie do K) X' (2006-01), 'zaufanie do X' (2008-01). In 2014 the battery was split across APiW 284 (January) and 286 (March). Asked in both 2014 halves of the battery.

items.wording: How would you rate your trust in the press, newspapers? (1 no trust ... 7 great trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-09 (APiW 148), 1 survey. 1 = no trust ... 7 = great trust.

items.wording: Do you trust the press? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: CBOS, 2004-09 (APiW 172), 1 survey. One-off CBOS trust questions answered 'zdecydowanie tak ... zdecydowanie nie' (not the 'mam zaufanie' battery).

items.wording: Do you trust television? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: CBOS, 2004-09 (APiW 172), 1 survey. One-off CBOS trust questions answered 'zdecydowanie tak ... zdecydowanie nie' (not the 'mam zaufanie' battery).

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the (written) press?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2004-2025, 21 surveys. 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale. Labels 'THE PRESS' (2004-05), 'PRESS' (2006-13), 'WRITTEN PRESS' (2014-19), 'TRUST IN MEDIA: WRITTEN PRESS' (2021-25).

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust television?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2004-2025, 21 surveys. 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale.

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the media?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2018-2026, 11 surveys. 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale.

items.wording: Trust in traditional media (newspapers, radio, television)
items.notes: PGSW 2023. 'Trust very much / rather trust / rather distrust / completely distrust'.
